scope: Independent content review of existing English request/candidate captions against scoped public source evidence; no new truth or training eligibility

axes.question: Does the candidate caption faithfully describe its scoped implementation, including incorrect behavior?
Does the request state its intended supported scope, and which parts does the candidate description cover, omit or contradict?
Are the required return, error, state, ownership, ordering and no-panic observations expressed with their finite scope?
Are relevant negation, inclusion/exclusion, malformed inputs, unsupported inputs and scope limitations explicit?

source_binding_requirements: Distinguish raw expression SHA, formatted complete declaration SHA and serialized literal-table SHA
Bind source ID to the original root function and historical code digest recipe
Preserve typed helper/type/method/global/sentinel components, historical bundle recipe and standard-library infrastructure exceptions
Reference verification alone does not approve complete source closure or reify Input/Want/Got
review_independence: Use an independent reader of original text and source evidence; a different reviewer does not create an independent data origin
selection_policy: Do not select or rewrite captions from observed 58 rankings, costs or group gains
preservation_policy: Keep original captions, candidate order/count, frozen truth, 17 groups and all 21 unknowns unchanged; narrower revisions require separate versions and original-family links
